evidence.description: A stolen car was driven into the storefront and towed for evidence
Police believe five people originally smashed in; four men who entered after that group left were arrested and booked for commercial burglary

unknowns: identity of the original group of five
notes: Cannabis shop. The four men arrested were described as opportunists who entered after the original group left; the original five were not reported identified. The MyNorthwest page was read by the research team but returned no content to a later check, so these details were not re-verified. No police statement links this incident to any other incident in the set.
